claim: Law 22-13 inserted CPCA article 536 مكرر 4: before the specialised commercial court the claim is registered only after a conciliation before a judge, and the opening petition must be accompanied by the record of non-conciliation on pain of inadmissibility in form. The record has no slot, prior step, document or boundary for this, although it carries the parallel article 17 paragraph 3 precisely because that sanction attaches to the petition itself; k63 lists publication only and sends formal notice, labour conciliation and mediation elsewhere, without naming this commercial conciliation.

source.what: Law 22-13 of 12 July 2022 amending and completing Law 08-09 (CPCA), Official Journal no. 48 of 17 July 2022, page 4, article 3 of the law inserting CPCA article 536 مكرر 4 (paragraphs 1 and 3). The store carries the same wording (cpca 536 مكرر 4, version law-22-13). Lead only (tier 3, university commentary, not read on joradp.dz): Executive Decree 23-53 of 14 January 2023 (JO 02/2023) fixed the twelve specialised commercial courts, which under Law 22-13 article 13 brings their jurisdiction into force on installation; a commentary says it was amended by an executive decree of 30 March 2026.

quoteArabic: يسبق قيد الدعوى إجراء الصلح الذي يتم بطلب من أحد الخصوم ويقدم إلى رئيس المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة ... في حالة فشل محاولة الصلح، ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بعريضة افتتاح الدعوى طبقا للقواعد المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون مرفقة، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا، بمحضر عدم الصلح.
consequence: A petition for a dispute listed in article 536 مكرر (intellectual property, commercial companies, judicial settlement and bankruptcy, banks and financial institutions against merchants, maritime and air transport and insurance linked to commercial activity, international trade) passes every check of this record and exports clean even when no conciliation was held and no non-conciliation record is attached, although the claim is then inadmissible in form. Case: a bank sues a merchant for an unpaid credit (like ex9 with a bank plaintiff); the record finds nothing. The record should ask whether the claim falls to the specialised commercial court and, if so, whether the record of non-conciliation is attached (or import it from a single module), and list that record among the documents.

claim: k23 answers «applies» to the statement that an administrative petition must be signed by a lawyer under article 815, and k22 to a lawyer being compulsory before the administrative court under article 826. Law 22-13 rewrote article 815 so that it no longer mentions a lawyer and repealed article 826; k32's note also says no article changed by Law 22-13 is cited here, while k22, k23 and k28 rest on 815, 826 and 828, all changed by it.

source.what: Law 22-13 of 12 July 2022, Official Journal no. 48 of 17 July 2022: article 6 of the law, page 6 (new CPCA article 815); article 14 of the law, page 11 (repeal of CPCA article 826).

quoteArabic: «المادّة 815 : ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة الإدارية بعريضة ورقية أو بالطريق الإلكتروني». ... تلغى : – الفقرات 7 و8 و9 و10 من المادّة 32 والمواد 826 و835 و836 و912 و913 و914 من القانون رقم 08-09
consequence: The checklist should not keep, as applying, the statement that an administrative petition must be signed by a lawyer or that a lawyer is compulsory before the administrative court under 815 and 826. It should record that the current 815 allows a paper or an electronic petition, and k32 should list 815, 826 and 828 as articles changed by Law 22-13. The n1 message itself is not affected, because it cites only 816 and 819.

claim: The record says the legal-aid ordinance is not in the store and that no exemption from the fees is known beyond a grant of legal aid. Ordinance 71-57 article 28, as rewritten by Law 09-02, grants legal aid as of right to common plaintiffs of this app: minors who are parties, the plaintiff in a maintenance claim, the mother in a custody claim, workers and their dependants in work-accident or occupational-disease claims, and disabled persons, among others. Read with CPCA article 417 paragraph 2, they are exempt from the judicial costs.

source.what: Law 09-02 of 25 February 2009 amending and completing Ordinance 71-57 of 5 August 1971 on legal aid, Official Journal no. 15 of 8 March 2009, page 11, new article 28 of the ordinance. No later amendment of article 28 was searched for on joradp.dz.

quoteArabic: «المادة 28 : تمنح المساعدة القضائية بقوة القانون إلى : 1 - أرامل وبنات الشهداء غير المتزوجات، 2 - معطوبي الحرب، 3 - القصر الأطراف في الخصومة، 4 - المدعي في مادة النفقة، 5 - الأم في مادة الحضانة، 6 - العمال في مادة حوادث العمل أو الأمراض المهنية وإلى ذوي حقوقهم، 7 - ضحايا الاتجار بالأشخاص أو بالأعضاء، 8 - ضحايا تهريب المهاجرين، 9 - ضحايا الإرهاب، 10 - المعوقين.»
consequence: o5, k52 and k66 should no longer be «searchedNotFound» for the as-of-right cases. The fee_exemption_applies question (p9) and doc4 should name these categories. A maintenance or custody petition, or one where a minor is a party, should not lead to a warning about unpaid fees when the exemption is not stated, as ex12 and ex14 would give; the record should ask, or the categories should be read from facts it already has (party_lacks_capacity, requests including maintenance or custody). The note on b32 should say that Law 90-04 article 25 is an addition to these as-of-right cases.
